column1: # Frozen CI gate baselines — polaris-fs migration
#   le = current count must be <= value (may only shrink)
#   ge = current count must be >= value (may only grow)
# A PR that needs to move a number updates THIS FILE in the same PR —
# the change is visible in review and must be justified in the PR description
# (e.g. a migrated module legitimately removes wrapping_* sites → lower the
# wrapping_ops floor for that crate with the claim ID in the commit message).
# Frozen 2026-07-30 at commit 2e49c26 (unmigrated baseline). Evidence: VC-01/VC-02.
# Baseline change (unused-unsafe sweep, 48 wrappers removed tree-wide):
# Baseline change (P1): plfscommon migration (12/14 modules safe-ified) dropped
# its unsafe 336 -> 244 and wrapping 940 -> 832; migration_iou floor raised to
# 1 for the charts IOU (verified-claims ledger, consumed by P2/P5).
# Baseline change (P0 dedup): plfscommon extraction moved shared modules out of
# the 6 daemon crates into the plfscommon crate; plfsclient extraction moved the
# 12 shared client modules out of plfsmount/plfsbdev into the plfsclient crate.
# Baseline change (P4 native ownership/thread wave): generated internal wrapper
# removal lowered wrapping floors: plfsclient 796 -> 723, plfsmount 410 -> 400.
# Baseline change (P6 charts): charts.c re-ported as safe imp/render cores
# (differential-tested vs C: fixed scenario x5 TZs + seeded fuzz). Transpiled
# copy's 495 wrapping ops replaced by ~70 explicit ones on the C-unsigned paths:
# Baseline change (P7 metalogger): masterconn.c re-ported as safe Rust on new
# safe plfscommon APIs (daemon::*_register, sockets::tcp); old-vs-new live
# diff (tools/metalogger_diff.sh) identical. Transpiled copy's wrapping ops
# replaced by explicit ones on the C-unsigned paths: plfsmetalogger wrapping
